params.body:
## What was wrong

A bidding offer's detail page showed the section "Schade" with the exploded drawing of the car, no marker on it and no damage card beside it. The section claimed damage and showed none.

There were two rules for "this car has damage":

- The section opened when a damage row had a note or a path that was **not null** (`whereNotNull`), so an empty string counted.
- The markers and cards inside that section showed a row only when the note was **not empty**, or a photo row existed.

A `vehicle_damage` row with `note = ''` and no photo opened the section and drew nothing.

Those rows come from the vehicle form itself. `OwnStockService::bootstrapDraft` sets up eighteen damage rows for every new car (R S1-1.1) and wrote them with `note = ''`. The classic sheet posted eighteen textareas, the request middleware turned the empty ones into NULL, and the first save cleaned the rows. The Livewire sheet rebuilds `car_damage` from the rows themselves (`VehicleForm::toBackendArray`), outside that middleware, so it wrote the empty strings straight back. Every car entered through the Livewire sheet that never got a damage carries eighteen rows that counted as damage.

The same not-null rule was repeated in more places, so the same cars also:

- lost the "no damage" banner on the Stocklist detail, the bidding detail and the dealer website detail;
- reported `<accident>1</accident>` in the portal feed (`has_damage`);
- dropped out of a dealer's website when that dealer has "Schade op detail verbergen" on (the filter looked for a row with a NULL note);
- printed a blank damage cell on the bidding agreement, where "Geen schade" belongs.

## What changed

**One definition.** `Damage::hasContent()`: a note with something in it (white space alone does not count), a photo path of its own, or at least one photo row that names a file. `Damage::photos()` are those photo rows. `Damage::scopeWithContent()` / `scopeWithoutContent()` are the same rule in SQL. `Vehicle::hasVisibleDamage()` is "any row with content", `Vehicle::visibleDamage()` the rows to show.

Every place that decided or listed damage now reads it:

| Where | Before | Now |
|---|---|---|
| `Vehicle::hasVisibleDamage()` (Stocklist detail, bidding detail, website detail, the "no damage" banner) | note or path not null, or media with a path | `visibleDamage()` |
| `Vehicle::count_damage` / `has_damage` (portal feed `<accident>`) | SQL: note or path not null | `damage()->withContent()` (now also counts a photo-only damage, as the pages do) |
| `stocklist/_tabs/damage.blade.php` | outer: not null; markers and cards: note not empty or any photo row | one list, `visibleDamage()`; photos from `photos()` |
| `website/tabs/damage.blade.php` | outer: not null (no media); inner: as above; location taken from the position in the collection | `visibleDamage()`; location from `location_id` |
| `offertes/offerte.blade.php`, `_tabs_offerte/damage` | inline copies of the rule | `hasVisibleDamage()`, `visibleDamage()` |
| `offertes/bestelbon.blade.php`, `history.blade.php`, `_tabs_bestelbon/damage` | `array_filter` on note and path (a photo-only damage did not open the table) | `hasVisibleDamage()` / `hasContent()` |
| `_tabs_bruikleen/damage` | note not null or any photo row | `visibleDamage()` |
| `export/print/agreement_partials/page_2` | "Geen schade" only for a car with no rows at all | `visibleDamage()`, "Geen schade" when it is empty |
| `vehicleResource` (`main.has_damage`, partner API) | `filled(note) || filled(path)` | `hasVisibleDamage()`; the two API reads eager-load `damage.media` |
| `VehicleRepository::withDealerSettings` | row with note NULL and path NULL | `withoutContent()` |

**Write paths.** A location that is set up is stored with a NULL note (`bootstrapDraft`, the copy in `OwnStockController`, `InsertTempVehicles`). `Damage` stores an empty or white-space note or path as NULL, whichever path writes it. `OwnStockService::update_vehicle_damage` creates no row for an empty note and does not touch a row whose note is already empty: a save of the sheet that changed no damage must not write to the damage rows, because a write there reads as "the damage changed" on a car under bidding (R B1-3.3).

**Existing rows are left alone.** The read rule makes them harmless. `php artisan stocklist:empty-damage-rows` counts them (rows, vehicles, per month) and changes nothing; it has no `--apply`.

**The tab is right for both callers.** `stocklist/_tabs/damage.blade.php` keeps its "no damage" line for a caller that includes it for a car without damage.

**Group title.** The option group title on the detail ("TECHNISCHE FICHE") is a name stored in capitals; no stylesheet sets it. `OptionGroup::title()` shows a name stored in capitals in sentence case and leaves any other name as it is (R P1-1.27).

## Left as it is, on purpose

- The website filter behind "Schade op detail verbergen" lets a car through when it has no damage rows or at least one empty one. With eighteen rows per car that is nearly every car, including one with damage. R S2-5.8 says otherwise, but dealers with that setting see their damaged cars on their website today, so following the rule would remove cars. Only the meaning of "empty" moved here; the question is recorded as an open finding (`bevinding: schade-verbergen-filtert-geen-wagens-met-schade`).
- The loan agreement keeps its damage table heading for every car; only the rows follow the rule.
- The dealer's own damage step in the vehicle form still lists a location with a photo row that names no file, so the dealer can remove it.

## Rules and tests

- R S1-6.44 (new) and R S1-6.17 (reworded); R S2-5.8 is marked disputed.
- Fixes bevinding een-lege-schadeplaats-telde-als-schade (`opgelost_in` this pull request).
- `DamageContentRuleTest`: the PHP rule and the SQL scope agree on eleven kinds of row; a car whose rows are empty strings shows no damage section on the Stocklist detail, the bidding detail and the dealer website detail, and says it has no damage (banner, `has_damage`, partner API); a photo row without a file does not count; a note and a photo each show with their marker on their own location; the tab says "no damage" when included for a car without; the bidding agreement; a new draft holds eighteen rows without a note; the model stores no empty note; saving empty notes writes no counting row and leaves old rows untouched; saving the Livewire sheet leaves the car free of damage; the command counts and changes nothing; the group title.
params.title: An empty damage row is no damage: one rule for the section, the markers, the documents and the feeds
